input_files.rule: Fixtures model process graphs, Windows paths, command status, and tasklist CSV without terminating real processes or writing the registry.

contracts.output contract: Return normalized inputs, complete affected members, identities, roles, blocked reasons, plan_id, preconditions, command status, and verified per-member outcomes. Never equate a successful command exit with confirmed termination.
contracts.rollback boundary: Process termination is irreversible and is controlled by audit, confirmation, complete closure, and precondition checks. Report files are local and removable. Version 2.0 performs no registry mutation; persistent Phone Link changes must use supported Windows Settings.
